# apple_game_center_leaderboard_order (Resource)

Sets the order in which the Game Center leaderboards of an app or of a group are shown. App Store Connect has no way to remove an order, so destroying the resource leaves the items as they are. Import it with `detail/<game_center_detail_id>` or `group/<game_center_group_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard_order" "example" {
  game_center_detail_id = apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  leaderboard_ids       = [apple_game_center_leaderboard.high_scores.id, apple_game_center_leaderboard.weekly.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `leaderboard_ids` (List of String) App Store Connect IDs of every leaderboard of the app or group, in order.

### Optional

- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center detail. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The owner's kind and App Store Connect ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_leaderboard_order.example
  identity = {
    id = "detail/7a9c1e3b-5d2f-4a6b-8c0e-3f5a7b9c1d2e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The owner's kind and App Store Connect ID, e.g. `detail/<id>`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The order of an app's items, by its Game Center detail.
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard_order.example detail/7a9c1e3b-5d2f-4a6b-8c0e-3f5a7b9c1d2e

# The order of a group's items.
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard_order.shared group/3a5c7e9b-1d2f-4b6a-8c0e-2f4a6b8c0d1e
```
